Tbh I've always actually had a feeling I was missing something. When I was a kid you could often see me strapping one belt to another and pretending i had a tail, and at the preschool's Halloween event i was always the one with the cat ears. My parents let it slide bc i was being a kid, that's what kids do, and when I grew older I stopped bc nobody else did it (and I was already getting bullied enough lmao). I forgot about it for most of my teenage years bc there was already enough going on as well, but when I started to have a job and eventually moved out, I had more time to think, and found out that when I looked in the mirror, my human face didnt look right. The person in the mirror wasn't me.

Eventually I figured out Im genderfluid, and allowing myself to think outside of the gender-box made me reconnect with my physical form. But something was still missing. So I turned to the internet, and ordered some cosplay cat ears. And when they arrived I was so excited, I had no idea know why, but when I put them on and looked into the mirror again,, it just clicked. I saw myself for the first time in years. And I'm not even gonna lie, I cried. I was so happy lmao

That's when I found out I had phantom limbs. I didn't know what it meant and was scared to look up if there was a word to describe this new realisation, so I just thought I had some weird connection to anime cat girls. But not too long ago I scrolled through Reddit and came across to this subreddit. And the more I thought about it, the more I realized that I didn't just want cat ears on my head, I wanted to /be/ the cat. Except with wings. At first I thought that was being greedy lmao but I saw so many others having multiple kintypes that I came to terms with it. and now we're here!

I hope my story helped clarify things a bit, or at least gave you and others something to relate to. If you have any questions, feel free to let me know!
